attempts.answer:
<thought>I'm building around Gholdengo as the centerpiece win condition, using its great typing and Good as Gold to block status while it snowballs with Nasty Plot. To support it, I'll bring strong pivots and answers to common threats: a fast Dragapult for offensive pressure, Corviknight for Defog and physical bulk, and Primarina to handle Dark and Dragon types. Garchomp gives a reliable ground-type and late-game sweeper, while Meowscarada provides speed control and Knock Off utility.</thought>
<pokemon>
Gholdengo
Dragapult
Corviknight
Primarina
Garchomp
Meowscarada
</pokemon>

attempts.answer:
<thought>Gholdengo gets Leftovers + Recover to set up Nasty Plot repeatedly behind Good as Gold. Dragapult runs Choice Scarf for speed control and U-turn pivoting into Gholdengo. Corviknight provides Defog, Body Press bulk, and a Steel answer; Primarina handles Dark/Dragons with Psychic Noise; Mega Garchomp gives a powerful mixed breaker with Stealth Rock, and Protean Meowscarada offers Knock Off utility and fast revenge killing with Focus Sash insurance.</thought>

attempts.reasoning:
Build sets. EV limit: 32 per stat, 66 total. Note that's unusual (like 63 EVs scaled). Spread ~32/32/2 etc.

Gholdengo: Nasty Plot, Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, Recover; Leftovers; 32 HP / 32 SpA / 2 SpD? Modest.

Dragapult: Dragon Darts, Shadow Ball, U-turn, Thunderbolt? Choice Scarf... but Gholdengo wants Leftovers. Give Dragapult Choice Scarf, Infiltrator.

Corviknight: Brave Bird, Body Press, Roost, Defog; Sitrus Berry? Mirror Armor; 32 HP/32 Def Impish.

Primarina: Moonblast, Sparkling Aria/Hydro Pump, Psychic Noise, Flip Turn; Mystic Water; Modest.

Garchomp: Earthquake, Dragon Claw/Scale Shot, Stealth Rock, Swords Dance? Garchompite mega! Garchomp holding Garchompite can mega. Mega Garchomp: Earthquake, Draco Meteor, Fire Blast, Swords Dance? Mixed: EQ, Draco Meteor, Fire Blast, Stealth Rock. Rough Skin.

Meowscarada: Knock Off, Flower Trick, U-turn, Taunt/Spikes; Protean; Focus Sash; Jolly 32/32.
